correctness.rationale: For every q=p^e the central quotient and exterior-square bracket force Aut(L)=Hom(V,Λ²V) ⋊ GL3. The ideal condition V∧U⊆W is necessary and sufficient, and each admissible pair has exactly q^{u(3−w)} graph ideals, a single central-shear orbit. Elementary wedge ranks and GL3 transitivity yield precisely 8 types of specified cardinalities; the sum and graded polynomial follow. A volume-form pairing independently verifies reciprocal dimensions. Exhaustive RREF enumeration and automorphism-orbit BFS over q=2 and q=3 matches every count. The infinite claim is established symbolically, not by finite experiments.

originality.rationale: The novel unit assessed is the exact full-automorphism orbit stratification of all Lie ideals in the six-dimensional free class-two rank-three algebra, not the ideal-count polynomial. Examination of the relevant introduction, main theorem, and proof sections of Voll’s public 2004 preprint shows aggregate zeta enumeration but no orbit table; Kofinas–Papistas’ accessible abstract concerns automorphism generators over Q. Extensive specific published-finding corpus queries find only unlike objects/invariants; the publicly retrieved comparison records were searched for stronger implications. A missing full text and unsearched synonym risk remain explicitly recorded, but there is no detected decisive stronger coverage.
residual_risks: The full Kofinas–Papistas paper could not be accessed; its abstract does not settle every possible overlap with orbit computations in the body.
An equivalent ideal-orbit classification may be known under a different name or in specialized tables not retrieved; similarity search absence is not global novelty proof.
Historical ideal-zeta theorems provide much broader counting results and may imply the displayed total ideal count; originality is limited to the complete automorphism-orbit partition and sizes.

value.rationale: The rank-three six-dimensional free class-two algebra is the first free two-step Lie example beyond the Heisenberg rank-two case. Its uniform eight-orbit stratification is a natural complete invariant of ideal embeddings and refines well-studied aggregate ideal zeta counts. It gives exact multiplicities in every characteristic, potentially useful for classifying quotients and comparing embedded ideals; it is not a cosmetic change of variables or a single unmotivated numerical count.
